paper_title: Temporally Consistent Object-Centric Learning by Contrasting Slots
venue: CVPR2025 pp5401-5411, verified official CVF proceedings page through existing proxy
official_binding: Author paper links slotcontrast.github.io whose Code link resolves to martius-lab/slotcontrast; exact experiment-checkpoint release binding is not asserted
license: MIT2023MaximilianSeitzer/AndriiZadaianchuk read fully. No source copied, executed or trained
paper_read_scope: Abstract/intro, method text3.1-3.2, experiment setup/object-discovery and dynamics text4.1-4.2, ablations4.3/conclusion5, appendixI/J/K/L; not all supplemental training tables or visual figures
original_task: Unsupervised video instance segmentation/decomposition and temporal slot consistency, with separately trained dynamics extension
model_inputs: Image-only Train video chunks. Frozen DINOv2 per-frame patch features projected into64D slots in inspected MOViC/YTVIS configs; no category text. Validation segmentation masks go to external mask metrics
model_outputs: Recurrent slots, per-slot soft pixel/patch masks and reconstructed frozen feature targets; no fixed Known classifier or prediction-owned persistent cross-video category ID
losses: Feature MSE weight1 plus adjacent-frame normalized slot cross-entropy weight0.5/temperature0.1. Actual batch_contrast concatenates slots across videos and uses identity soft CE target; all other batch slots are competing alternatives, including potentially same-category different instances
training_protocol: Learned fixed initialization,2SlotAttention GRU/MLP iterations(3firstframe),current-slot Transformer predictor, MLP feature decoder. Adam100ksteps, batch64/fourframechunks, frozen DINO encoder. MOViC lr0.0004/YTVIS0.0008; validation full-video mask metrics
online_or_offline: Offline self-supervised representation training on chunks; inference uses recurrent scan reset from learned initialization per video. Wholevideo frame encoder is mapped independently before forward recurrent scan
causal_or_noncausal: Inspected base recurrent update uses only prior slots/current features and predictor over current slots, not futureframe attention. Structural source evidence is not actual changed-future mutation certification or external persistent stream adapter acceptance. Multi-frame training objectives are not automatically illegal future leakage
state_memory: Fixed slots reset pervideo; no inspected crossvideo semantic bank, candidate-set category controller, tentative/confirmed/quarantine state, reversible split/merge event lineage or versioned category tokens
evaluation: VideoARI/VideoIoU flatten time within each video; mBO uses independently best-overlap GT mask matching, not fixed Known/category CT. Config MOVi background ignored, YTVIS background included; these instance metrics cannot substitute for TAO category metrics
static_source_details_not_measured_failu: models.py244 initializes each input video afresh; video.pyScanOverTime loops current index and passes state_predicted forward
Contrast loss treats same slot across adjacent frames as positive and other videos/slots as alternatives; not lawful category-supervised same-category multi-positive learning
Custom attention sets scale=head_dim**-0.5 then divides q byscale at networks.py516. Do not silently replace this with a different scaling and call it upstream reproduction
No released checkpoint downloaded or executed; source/dependency compatibility, dense-stream API and exact pretrained release binding remain untested
paper_limitations_summary: Fixed slot count, mask sharpness, long occlusion errors and uncontrolled behavior of disappeared-object slots
what_to_borrow: Temporal visual-consistency controls as a physical/representation hypothesis, explicitly separating identity from semantic category compatibility and retaining Raw/frozen baselines
what_not_to_borrow: Cross-instance batch negatives as category multi-positive supervision, pervideo slot index as persistent category, mask overlap/ARI as CT, recurrent source inspection as end-to-end causality PASS
